facts.text: Deborah explained a modified pose involving sitting on the edge of a chair, twisting the torso, and using the hand on the knee for support.

evidence.quote: To do this modified pose, sit on the edge of a chair with your feet planted. Twist your torso to one side and use your hand on your knee for support.

facts.text: Deborah mentioned that the pose helps in relaxing tense muscles by stretching the back and shoulders.

evidence.quote: You'll feel a stretch in your back and shoulders as you hold it for a few breaths.
